references.phrase: left group action G on X

references.context: Subset of G consisting of g such that g dot x equals x for fixed x in X.

references.phrase: pointwise action evaluation g dot x
references.context: Evaluation of given left action at an ordered pair (g,x), using the specified group action.

references.disposition: Stabilizer is necessarily a subgroup of G, but the displayed definition is the fixing-element subset.

review_rationale: Read point stabilizer as all group elements fixing a chosen x under the specified left action; recognized subgroup closure as a consequence, not as an alternative orbit definition.
